# DiskANN Vector Index and Vector Search Are Now Generally Available in Azure SQL

## What Changed

Today, we are announcing the general availability of DiskANN Vector Index & Search across Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance with the always-up-to-date update policy, and SQL database in Microsoft Fabric.
